title: Pure Jinzo
summary: Pure Jinzo anti-Trap control and machine beatdown build, shutting down opposing Traps under the absolute rule of the psychic cyborg. The deck uses Psychic Bounder and Jinzo - Jector to search and deploy original Jinzo alongside Jinzo - Energy Shocker, wiping backrows on arrival, locking out Trap Cards completely, and stealing opposing monsters with Jinzo - Layered.

summary.title: Starters
points: Psychic Bounder searches Jinzo or a Spell/Trap mentioning it (such as Law of the Cosmos or Cyber Energy Shock) upon Normal or Special Summon, and destroys an attacking monster during the Damage Step.

Jinzo - Jector is treated as Jinzo on the field and in the GY: it tributes itself to search any Jinzo monster, reveals all Set cards in the opponent's Spell & Trap Zones, and Special Summons Jinzo monsters from your hand up to the number of Traps revealed.
Psychic Wave sends a Machine monster from your Deck to the GY (placing Jinzo in the GY), and banishes itself from the GY to retrieve a Machine monster.
Psychic Megacyber Special Summons itself from hand if the opponent controls more Spells and Traps than you do, providing a free Level 6 body.

summary.title: Opening: Psychic Bounder + Law of the Cosmos
steps: Normal Summon Psychic Bounder and activate its effect to search Law of the Cosmos (or Cyber Energy Shock) from your Deck.
Activate Law of the Cosmos: the opponent may Set 1 Trap directly from their hand or Deck; if they do, you Special Summon 1 Jinzo directly from your Deck.
If the opponent declines to Set a Trap, Law of the Cosmos adds 1 Jinzo or 1 monster mentioning it from your Deck to your hand.
Special Summon Jinzo the Machine Menace from your hand if a Trap is face-up or in either GY.
Tribute Machine Menace to Special Summon Jinzo from your hand or GY and destroy all Traps your opponent controls.

summary.title: The Trap Lockdown
points: Jinzo prevents Trap Cards and their effects on the field from being activated, and completely negates all Trap effects on the field.

Jinzo - Energy Shocker destroys all face-up Traps the opponent controls on summon, counts as Jinzo on field and in GY, and prevents the opponent from activating Trap Cards or effects while a second copy is on your field or in your GY.

Jinzo - Lord cannot be Normal Summoned/Set: it is Special Summoned by sending a face-up Jinzo you control to the GY, negates all Traps, and destroys all face-up Traps once per turn while burning for 300 per destroyed Trap.
Jinzo - Returner Special Summons a Jinzo from your GY whenever it is sent to the GY, providing instant revival.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Xyz
points: Cyber Energy Shock targets and destroys 1 card on the field while you control Jinzo, and if it was a Trap, allows you to destroy another card or give all Jinzo monsters 800 ATK.
Everlasting Alloy is a Quick-Play Spell that protects your Machine monsters from being destroyed by card effects and prevents them from being targeted while you control Jinzo.
Jinzo - Layered (Rank 6 Xyz) detaches 1 material to take control of an opponent's face-up monster until the End Phase, and destroys 1 face-up card on the field if a Trap is on the field.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Dark Time Wizard hybrid engine is omitted in favor of a focused, pure Jinzo and psychic machine strategy.

main: Jinzo - Energy Shocker
Newest support. Summoned: destroys every Trap the opponent controls; a second copy on your field or in your GY locks their Traps.
Jinzo
The original: no Trap can be activated, and Trap effects on the field are negated.
Jinzo the Machine Menace
Summons itself while a Trap is face-up or in a GY; tributes itself to bring back Jinzo and clear their Traps.
Psychic Bounder
Summoned: searches Jinzo or a Spell/Trap that names it.
Jinzo - Jector
Counts as Jinzo; tributes itself to search a Jinzo monster and summons more if they have Set Traps.
Psychic Megacyber
Summons itself when the opponent has more Spells/Traps; a Level 6 for Jinzo - Layered.
Jinzo - Returner
Sent to the GY: revives Jinzo for the turn.
Jinzo - Lord
Summoned by sending a face-up Jinzo to the GY: locks Traps and burns for each one it destroys.
Psychic Wave
Sends Jinzo from the Deck to the GY; later recycles a Machine from the GY.
Law of the Cosmos
Summons Jinzo from the Deck if the opponent Sets a Trap, or searches a Jinzo card if they don't.
Cyber Energy Shock
With Jinzo out: destroys a card, and negates another or boosts Jinzo if it was a Trap.
Everlasting Alloy
With Jinzo out: protects your Machines from destruction or negates a targeting effect.
extra: Rank 6 for two Level 6s: borrows an opposing monster and destroys a face-up card while a Trap is on the field.
